name: MCNUCM1
tagline: 13.5 mm slim Intel N100 / N150 desktop mini PC
description: MCNUCM1 combines an Intel N100 or N150 processor with 8, 12 or 16 GB onboard LPDDR5X in a 159 × 80 × 13.5 mm metal-and-glass enclosure. One M.2 2280 SSD slot supports SATA or PCIe 3.0 ×4 storage. HDMI, USB-C DisplayPort, Gigabit Ethernet and 65 W USB-C PD power provide desktop connectivity, with optional VESA mounting.

specs.label: Rear I/O
